label: Q3 2026 (July–September)
source: CCCM Cluster Somalia Site Monitoring Report Q3 2026 v1.3, published 13 October 2026

topRed.gap: have latrines and bathing spaces not separated by gender
had no food or cash distribution for over six months

keyFindings: 57% of its indicator results scored Red (based on 3 or fewer indicators — interpret with caution)
12 of 26 Mogadishu catchment areas were not assessed this quarter
keyFindingSentences: Shelter has the widest sector gap: 57% of its results are Red (only 3 indicators). 62% of sites report households needing emergency shelter; 77% have no shelter repair kits.
60% of sites have no psychosocial support. 29% (380 sites) report unaccompanied or separated children.
84% of sites have latrines and bathing spaces not separated by gender. 37% of latrines are not functional; about 106 people share each functional latrine (Sphere standard: 20).
69% of sites (919) have never received an on-site food or cash distribution.
Data gap: 84 of 302 sites did not answer one question (using cash without restrictions), so that indicator rests on 218 sites only.
Highest severity (districts with 10 or more sites): Xudun 70% (10 sites), Afgooye 66% (12 sites), Xudur 63% (69 sites).
Strengths: 98% of sites have an inclusive Camp Management Committee, and 94% a functioning complaints and feedback mechanism.
popNote: Households and people from the CCCM IDP Site Master List for the 1,117 assessed sites that could be matched to it.
